items.title: Persona look
items.body: Persona 4 style for the stats panel, fights, Shuffle Time and dungeons. Yellow, blue or red, or your own accent, HP and SP colours (Settings → Theme).

items.title: The chat, Persona style
items.body: A date strip on the last reply, a card when the day changes, a banner for a new place, and what each reply raised: social stats and bonds.

items.title: Together mode
items.body: The tracker block has the last word on the reply's format; a reply that comes back without it gets a separate call; a warning when the context is too small.

items.title: Fairer enemies
items.body: Enemies now grow like the Personas of the Compendium: a level 1 Shadow has the stats of a level 1 Persona, not five times more.

items.title: Change Persona in battle
items.body: A Wild Card can switch Persona on their turn — free, once a turn — with its own stats, affinities and skills.
